about: Hand-curated venue research for Challenge ISRAMAN, keyed by the code its festival-site adapter gives each place the schedule names. The schedule numbers its places on its map: (1) Isrotel Sport Club, (2) the expo compound in the Royal Garden's car park, (3) Royal Beach. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

royal-beach-hotel.name: Isrotel Royal Beach
royal-beach-hotel.notes: The athletes' briefings, through the hotel's main entrance (the schedule).

royal-beach.name: Royal Beach (חוף רויאל)
royal-beach.notes: The swim start, point (3) on the schedule's map, and the swim-course clinics.

royal-garden.name: Isrotel Royal Garden
royal-garden.notes: The expo compound in the car park is point (2) on the schedule's map, where the race winners arrive.
